verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Flagsmith publishes a pricing page at flagsmith.com/pricing, but the only content cited from it is plan-gated features (SAML/SSO, 2FA). Nothing in the pack shows actual prices or what drives cost. Missing for 10: published price points per plan, explanation of cost drivers (seats, MAUs, API requests/events), usage limits or overage terms, and independent corroboration of pricing clarity.
